steps.label: Shape
steps.margin_note: Expansion plus the shape. Two lines.
lines: TMV stands for TOBACCO MOSAIC VIRUS.
steps.why: The rod shape comes from its capsomeres being stacked in a helix rather than packed into a sphere.
common_mistakes: Saying TMV is spherical or polyhedral. It is ROD shaped.
Not expanding TMV. The full name is part of a complete answer.
steps.memory_tip: A rod, because the coat is a helix.

steps.label: Genetic material
lines: Its genetic material is SINGLE STRANDED RNA.
It lies spirally coiled inside the hollow core.
steps.why: TMV is one of the standard examples of an RNA virus, which is why this fact is asked so often.
common_mistakes: Saying TMV has DNA. Its genetic material is RNA.
Saying the RNA is double stranded. It is SINGLE stranded.
